ATTACHMENT 1
Resource – Assignment Details:

Number of Resources required 1 Category 1- General Auditor 2 -Technical Auditor 3 - IT Auditor Category 1- General Auditor Dates Required Fieldwork phase – 11 May to 5 June 2025 No. of Working Days 20 Days Location Doha HSE – type of HSE Office based and Site Safety. Data Confidentiality – list any specific requirements Contractor shall not discuss or share any information related to the assignment and obtained during the Audit with any other person outside of the Company Audit Team. Scope of Services: To participate as an Auditor in the Company Internal Audit Team to evaluate and assess the Management of Privatized Companies process including the following sub processes: Corporate Governance Financial Consolidation and Reporting Management Reporting Compliance Management Public and Investor Relations Data and Records Management Cost Allocation Services required: Perform audit work in accordance with Company internal auditing standards and IIA Standards. Review, understand and execute the audit program to meet the audit objectives.

Document the audit testing results in a timely manner, with high quality and adequate working papers (using templates provided). Audit findings/observations to be well documented in Audit Memos with adequate supporting documentation. Discuss and agree the potential observations / gaps identified with the Lead Auditor on a timely basis. Discuss and agree with the auditee/client the agreed observations / gaps Document Audit Memos (within 2 days from their identification and agreement) and have them approved by the Lead Auditor. Audit Areas to be covered The relevant qualification and experience are required to cover the following audit scope areas: Financial Reporting Financial Consolidation Management Reporting Cost allocation
